endpoints.title: Forward Message
endpoints.description:
Sends a copy of a message from another channel into this one, with its text, files and rich embeds, and a note of where it came from.

You need to be able to read the original (view the channel and read its history) and to send here, with the same rules as any message you send (files need Upload Files, rich embeds need Send Embeds). A message from a mature channel goes only into another mature channel. A forwarded copy notifies nobody it mentions. A poll is forwarded as text: its question and answers, without votes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate requests

restrictions: Forwarding is switched on per instance: `GET /` shows `features.forwarding`. Where it is off the answer is FeatureDisabled.

endpoints.title: Search for Messages
endpoints.description: This route searches for messages within the given parameters: words, authors, a mentioned user, what a message has (`link`, `file`, `image`, `video`, `embed`, `sound`), a time window by id or date, and pinned. Every filter given must match. Bots may only list pinned messages (`pinned: true`): searching text would let a bot read messages its intents hide.
restrictions: Bots may only list pinned messages (`pinned: true`); text search answers IsBot.

endpoints.title: Start Typing
endpoints.description: Show that you are typing in a channel. Clients hide it again after a few seconds or when your message arrives. For bots without a gateway connection; connected clients send `BeginTyping` instead.

endpoints.title: Search for Messages in a Server
endpoints.description: Searches the server's channels that you may read: you need to view the channel and read its history, and mature channels are for declared adults only. Other channels are left out silently, never reported. Takes the same filters as a channel search, plus `channels` to search only some of them. Bots may only list pinned messages (`pinned: true`).
restrictions: Bots may only list pinned messages (`pinned: true`); text search answers IsBot.
